# Security Checklist: SPEC-009C3 - Dev/Review/Aegis to Ready for Owner

**Purpose**: Validate security, trust-boundary, and evidence-sanitization requirement quality for SPEC-009C3 before task generation and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-05-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are fixture and live PR identity requirements defined separately so automated validation cannot spoof live GitHub proof? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-014a]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements complete for rejecting unrelated repository, unrelated PR number, wrong-task PR ownership, and missing PR linkage before owner-ready state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-010b, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK003 Are Aegis approval requirements complete for reviewer identity, canonical `quality_reviews` linkage, correct workspace scope, and correct PR-producing dev task subject? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-010b, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are artifact data-protection requirements complete for excluding secrets, access tokens, credentials, connection strings, raw sensitive source, and raw sensitive logs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010c, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Stage Artifact]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the boundary between deterministic fixture evidence and live GitHub evidence stated with unambiguous source indicators and acceptance limits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Glossary, Data Model §Dev Verification Artifact]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "operator-initiated" live draft PR smoke clarified as opt-in UAT only, outside ordinary automated tests and autopilot acceptance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-009, Quickstart §Optional Live Draft PR Smoke]
- [ ] CHK007 Are artifact payload constraints specific enough to distinguish bounded evidence metadata from raw secret-bearing command output or logs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a, Spec §FR-010c, Contract §Stage Artifact Envelope]
- [ ] CHK008 Is Aegis approval authority clearly assigned to the existing `quality_reviews` row rather than to the `aegis_approval` artifact alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Session 2026-05-16, Contract §Aegis Approval]

## Requirement Consistency

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can the security-critical rejection paths be objectively measured for wrong workspace, non-`aegis` reviewer, fixture/live PR misuse, missing PR linkage, and invalid live-smoke evidence? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-006, Spec §SC-011]

## Scenario Coverage
